Hierarchical KV cache for distributed serving

A hierarchical KV cache keeps hot prefixes in GPU memory, warm prefixes in host memory and cold prefixes on remote storage.

When a request arrives, the scheduler looks up the longest cached prefix across all tiers and prefetches the missing blocks before prefill starts.

Under tensor and pipeline parallelism every rank stores its own shard of the cache, so the lookup and the prefetch have to stay consistent across ranks.
